name: Opportunity Mission Objectives
notes: To Win the battle, you must achieve the objective (even if you are subsequently chased from the battlefield, unless the objective states otherwise). If this is the final battle of a Quest, it is always a Fight Off objective and you must add +1 to the number of enemies faced.

rows.detail: You Win if at least 2 crew members move off the opposing battlefield edge. If you drive off all enemies, you Win as long as you have at least 2 crew members remaining.

A crew member of your choosing is carrying a package that must be delivered to the exact center of the table (placing it requires a Combat Action). If the carrier becomes a casualty, roll 1D6: on a 1, the item is destroyed; otherwise it can be picked up by spending a Combat Action at the location they fell. If you drive off all enemies, you Win as long as the package is undamaged.

You must reach a computer console in the exact center of the battlefield and gain access: 1D6+Savvy, scoring a 6+. A Combat Action is required for each attempt; up to two characters can attempt every round. Soulless can attempt it while within 6". Engineer or Bot crew add +1. A natural 1 means the system is hardened; a second natural 1 during the battle means the mission fails (Engineers ignore natural 1s). Once accessed, you Win. If you drive off all enemies, you must still roll, using any remaining crew member.

Tally up the large terrain features (or equivalent clusters) and select 3 at random. A crew member must end a move within 2" of each feature. Once all 3 have been checked, you Win. If you drive off the enemy, you can do this at your leisure.
There is no objective other than driving off the enemy. To Win, you must Hold the Field.
